metadata.title: Application Identity and Authorization

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for identifying actors and enforcing authorization decisions within applications.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Application-level authentication contexts, authorization logic, permission models, and policy enforcement mechanisms.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Pattern for enforcing identity-aware and policy-driven authorization decisions inside applications.

props.name: depends-on
props.remarks: Application identity and authorization assumes baseline application ownership, intent, and lifecycle governance.

metadata.remarks: Application Identity and Authorization defines trust properties required for applications to identify actors and enforce access control correctly. This pattern focuses on authorization decisions at the point of business logic execution, not infrastructure authentication or network enforcement.

components.title: Actor Identity Establishment
components.description: Establishes reliable identity context for users and non-human actors within the application.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Use of valid credentials to impersonate legitimate application users or services.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Masquerading as a different user or role within application context.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Strong identity binding and context propagation within applications.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Application establishes authenticated identity context for actors.
Identity attributes are available to application authorization logic.

components.title: Authorization Decision Making
components.description: Evaluates whether an identified actor is permitted to perform a requested action.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Abuse of trusted application pathways to bypass authorization logic.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Policy-based access control and authorization enforcement.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Application enforces authorization checks for protected actions.
Authorization decisions follow least privilege principles.

components.title: Role and Permission Model Governance
components.description: Defines and constrains roles, permissions, and privilege boundaries within the application.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Manipulation of account permissions to expand application privileges.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Policy enforcement preventing unsanctioned privilege expansion.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Policies define allowable roles and permission assignments.

components.title: Authorization Observability and Decision Audit
components.description: Provides visibility into authorization decisions for oversight and investigation.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Suppression of evidence related to improper access or authorization failures.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Authorization decisions are logged by the application.
Audit review supports investigation of application access behavior.
